answer: We formalize a Sybil-resistant mechanism where an attacker faces an adversarial gale of slashed staking collateral. By tying identity creation to an umber registry secured by zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions, we impose a glacier of locked opportunity cost. For any multiplier k > 1, the expected utility function E[U] = V(k) - k * C converges to a strictly negative value when the subgame-perfect slashing penalty exceeds the value of coordination. This enforces a unique, robust Nash equilibrium where honest participation dominates.
